title: Why ASCAP was the right choice
summary: He praises ASCAP for meticulous records and steady checks since 1957.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: And there being an ASCAP to take care of composers.
Oh, yes, and for there being an ASCAP. So I've been an ASCAP composers since 1957.

...one of the best choices I ever made. Because I could have been with BMI, but BMI is a different setup. ASCAP keeps meticulous records, and four times a year after twenty years there's still a pretty decent check in the mail from... Well, I have many other tunes, as I've been mentioning here, but that "Primrose Lane" is the one that really keeps the thing up.
